sql: SELECT (SELECT win_rate FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_close_quarter WHERE quarter='2026-Q2') - (SELECT win_rate FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_close_quarter WHERE quarter='2026-Q1') AS diff_pp_fraction_x100 -- placeholder
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_closed = false AND lower(stage_id) = 'contract sent' AND created_quarter < '2026-Q4'
SELECT SUM(deals_reached_to) * 1.0 / SUM(deals_reached_from) FROM main.mart_stage_conversion WHERE from_stage = 'Qualified to buy' AND to_stage = 'Presentation scheduled'
SELECT AVG(amount) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_won AND closed_quarter = '2026-Q3'
SELECT SUM(deals_won) FROM main.mart_owner_win_rate WHERE owner_name ILIKE '%rep B%' AND quarter LIKE '2026-%'
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_lost AND closed_quarter = '2026-Q3'
SELECT (win_rate_now - win_rate_reported) * 100 FROM main.mart_win_rate_reported_vs_now WHERE quarter = '2026-Q1'
SELECT share_still_open FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_created_cohort WHERE cohort_quarter = '2026-Q3'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE closed_quarter = '2026-Q2' AND was_moved_back
SELECT MEDIAN(days_to_close) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_won AND closed_quarter LIKE '2026-%'
